issue_context.title: cli.github.com help topic page not rendering properly
issue_context.body:
The help topic rendering on `cli.github.com` is broken and results in incomplete rendering as seen [here](https://cli.github.com/manual/gh_help_formatting). It appears the `formatting` page is the only one that is actually broken.

cc https://github.com/cli/cli/issues/3488#issuecomment-917718648
comments: It looks like `gh help formatting` is defined in https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/trunk/pkg/cmd/root/help_topic.go#L81-L123. Comparing this to https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/trunk/pkg/cmd/release/download/download.go#L38-L56, which [does render correctly](https://cli.github.com/manual/gh_release_download), it's a very different way of writing it - split into "Examples", "Long" Cobra command heredocs vs. one single string. 🤔

review_comments: This argument to Docf was necessary to insert a literal `` ` `` into a backtick-delimited string. Please don't remove it.

Done.

I also removed trailing `\` since the shell can already handle multi-line input when users press enter after an opening quote.
